title: Bridgeweek priority triage and staffing slots (Q3 bridge) v0.1
body:
Purpose:
- Rapid decision notebook for Bridgeweek (Q3 bridge) to: 1) surface highest-impact asks for the next 6 weeks, 2) allocate limited cross-functional staffing slots, and 3) draft the all-hands micro-slate that communicates clear tradeoffs to the company.

Context / constraints (quick):
- Hiring freeze for two headcount bands continuing through mid-Q3; must reassign existing FTEs for high-priority work.
- Dedicated runway for Redwood Optimize experiments (2 engineers, 1 data scientist) cannot be touched — keep as committed.
- Execs prefer 2 clear cross-company asks, 1 infrastructure safety ask, and a short list of low-effort wins for morale.

High-level decision heuristic (proposal):
- Score asks by: customer impact (1-5), revenue/retention impact (1-5), risk reduction (1-5), and effort (S/M/L).
- Triage rule: pick top 2-3 items with combined effort <= 3 M-equivalents (i.e., two medium + one small or three small + one medium).
- If conflicting priorities between product and infra, infra safety takes precedence for SLA/external customers.

Candidate asks (raw list — needs scoring):
1) Hosted API latency initiative: reduce p95 by 15% on common traces — product + serving-runtime (estimated: 2 engineers, 4w M).
2) Dedicated regional expansion (EU-central): enable Dedicated capacity in one new region (estimated: org coordination, infra + legal, 3w L).
3) Private deployment onboarding playbook: 1-click VPC template + audit checklist (estimated: 1 eng, 2w S).
4) Cost-tuning sprint for top-10 customers: batching/quant profiles (estimated: 2 engs, 3w M).
5) Console rollout: per-route tracing defaults + docs (estimated: 1 eng, 2 design, 3w M).
6) Reliability safety: improve failover to cheaper-compatible model variants when high-load events happen (estimated: 1 eng, 3w M) — infra safety flag.
7) Internal developer experience: SDK polish and quickstart templates (estimated: 1 eng, 1w S) — morale/PLG.
8) Redwood Optimize pilot: automated quant recommendation for 3 workloads (blocked, reserved).
9) Customer success enablement kit for enterprise onboarding (1 PM, 2 weeks S).

Preliminary scoring (quick, for triage meeting):
- Ask 1 (Latency): customer 4, revenue 3, risk 2, effort M
- Ask 2 (Region): customer 3, revenue 4, risk 3, effort L
- Ask 3 (Playbook): customer 2, revenue 2, risk 2, effort S
- Ask 4 (Cost tuning): customer 5, revenue 5, risk 2, effort M
- Ask 5 (Console): customer 3, revenue 2, risk 2, effort M
- Ask 6 (Failover): customer 4, revenue 3, risk 5, effort M (infra safety)
- Ask 7 (SDK): customer 2, revenue 2, risk 1, effort S
- Ask 9 (CS kit): customer 3, revenue 3, risk 1, effort S

Suggested Bridgeweek staffing slots (timeboxed):
- Slot A (priority engineering): 2 full-time engineers for 3 weeks (own: product + serving-runtime) — target: pick either Ask 1 or Ask 4.
- Slot B (infra safety slot): 1 engineer + 1 SRE for 3 weeks (own: infra) — reserved for Ask 6 or immediate failsafe items.
- Slot C (playbook + docs): 1 engineer (0.5), 1 PM (0.3) for 2 weeks — target: Ask 3 + quickstarts.
- Slot D (CS + GTM): 1 PM + 1 CSM for 2 weeks (S) — target: Ask 9 and customer comms.
- Slot E (morale/PLG wins): 1 eng for 1 week — SDK polish or small console polish (Ask 7 or small parts of Ask 5).

All-hands micro-slate (30m total plan) — draft run-of-show:
- 0-5m: CEO framing: "Why we pick what we pick" — one slide on resource reality + guardrails.
- 5-12m: Priority 1 announcement + owner + expected impact (concrete metrics, e.g., p95-15% / $X saves).
- 12-19m: Priority 2 announcement + infra safety brief and fallback commitments.
- 19-25m: Quick wins: 3 bullet wins we can ship in 2 weeks (SDK quickstart, playbook template, CS kit).
- 25-30m: Q&A and feedback loop: how to submit post-Bridge asks (form + triage SLA).

Open questions / decision points to resolve before Friday triage meeting:
- Exec ask: do we prioritize revenue (Ask 4) or latency for product-led growth (Ask 1) as top slot? (S/decision: CEO + GTM + Eng leads)
- Legal/Privacy: can we open EU region timeline without additional controls? (owner: Legal — Asha)
- Dependencies: who is the SPOC for Redwood Optimize pilot (blocked slot) — needs confirmation.
- Can Dedicated capacity expansion be scoped to a minimal MVP to reduce cross-org effort? (product + infra)

Immediate action items (owners and dates):
- Morgan: run scoring workshop with Eng leads, PMs, CS — due 2025-02-24.
- Asha: quick legal check on EU region compliance scope — due 2025-02-27.
- Diego: confirm infra availability for Slot B and any SRE costs — due 2025-02-25.
- Priya: draft one-slide summary for CEO framing and list of metrics for each candidate ask — due 2025-02-26.
- Sophie: create the triage form and link (Confluence + JIRA template) — due 2025-02-24.

Notes to self / meeting prep (informal):
- Keep the all-hands slate tight — teams are burnt out by long comms. We must give explicit "what we won't do" bullets.
- Prepare a fallback: if Slot A chooses Ask 1 but we fail, auto-fallback to Ask 4 (cost tuning) to preserve customer value.
- Consider running a lightweight pulse (Slack emoji reaction) after the all-hands to measure sentiment on chosen priorities.

References / links (quick):
- Confluence: bridgeweek-playbook (see linked_artifacts).
- JIRA epic: JIRA-3421 (placeholder for triage).
- GH: GH-PR-785 (prototype console tracing defaults).

Versioning note: this is v0.1 — expect v0.2 after scoring workshop and exec input.
